title: Isolation of Adult Human Dermal Fibroblasts from Abdominal Skin and Generation of Induced Pluripotent Stem Cells Using a Non-Integrating Method
protocol: Clean and autoclave one large pair of surgical scissors.
Autoclave two sets of fine forceps.
Sterilize two pairs of microdissecting scissors through autoclaving.
Prepare 1 L sterile bottle, 500 mL sterile bottle, and a 250 mL sterile bottle by autoclaving.
Prepare 100 mm plates for use.
Prepare 60 mm plates for use.
Prepare 35 mm plates for use.
Sterilize disposable scalpels before use.
Autoclave 50 mL sterile tubes.
Sterilize 15 mL sterile tubes through autoclaving.
Store prepared instruments under sterile conditions until needed.
Clean cover glasses in a glass plate with 70% ethanol.
Aspirate the ethanol after a few seconds of contact with cover glasses.
Dry cover glasses in an oven at 37 °C.
Autoclave dried cover glasses before use.
Prepare 1 L of Hank's balanced salt solution (HBSS) at pH 7.4 by dissolving powdered salts in double-distilled sterile water and adding sodium bicarbonate.
Sterilize HBSS by filtration under a sterile hood.
Store sterilized HBSS at +4 °C until needed.
Prepare 500 mL of sterile 1x phosphate-buffered-saline (PBS) by dissolving specified amounts in sterile double-distilled water.
Check the pH value (7.4) and sterilize under a sterile hood by filtration.
Store PBS at +4 °C until use.
Prepare 50 mL of trypsin stop solution (TSS) by adding 5 mL of 10% fetal bovine serum (FBS) to 45 mL of HBSS under a sterile hood.
Store TSS at +4 °C until use.
Prepare Dulbecco's modified Eagle medium for fibroblast isolation (I-DMEM) using specified amounts and supplements under a sterile hood.
Store I-DMEM at +4 °C until use.
Prepare the DMEM for fibroblasts synchronization (S-DMEM) using 250 mL of DMEM supplemented with 0.1% FBS and 0.5% penicillin and streptomycin (pen/strep) under a sterile hood.
Store S-DMEM at +4 °C until use.
Wash the freshly obtained sample of human skin from abdomen in a 100 mm dish with HBSS solution.
Gently shake to remove blood and other biological fluids.
Repeat washing step three times, changing the HBSS solution and the plate at each wash.
Place the sample in a 100 mm plate.
Remove hair and fat using fine forceps and scissors.
Dissect the tissue to obtain 2 mm x 1 mm fragments (for a total of 16 fragments).
Place 4 small fragments in each 35 mm dish.
Cover the fragments with a sterile 22 mm x 22 mm cover glass.
Add 1.5 mL of I-DMEM to each dish.
Incubate the plates at 37 °C in 5% CO2 for about 15 days or until cells reach 85% confluence.
Change the culture medium every 3 days.
Check the outgrowth of cells using an inverted phase-contrast microscope daily.
Lift the cover glasses with fine forceps.
Place them upside-down in one 100 mm dish and wash with 1x sterile PBS.
Remove fragments of the samples and discard them.
Wash plates with 1x sterile PBS.
Add 3 mL and 1 mL of trypsin-EDTA to cover glasses placed in the 100 mm dish and 35 mm dishes, respectively.
Incubate for 5 min at 37 °C with 5% CO2.
Block the trypsinization by adding 5 mL of TSS to the 100 mm dish and 2 mL of TSS to each 35 mm dish.
Collect the suspension into 15 mL sterile tubes.
Centrifuge at 400 x g at 4 °C for 5 min.
Aspirate the supernatant and resuspend the pellet in 12 mL of I-DMEM.
Split the cell suspension into 3 mL aliquots for each 60 mm plate.
Incubate at 37 °C with 5% CO2.
Change the medium daily.
Keep cells in culture until they reach a confluence of 75%.
Aspirate the medium from the plates and quickly wash in 1x PBS.
Repeat trypsinization three times to obtain cells at passage 4.
Use 1.5 mL of trypsin-EDTA and 3 mL of TSS in each 60 mm dish.
Split the cells 1:3.
Synchronize the cells by replacing the I-DMEM with S-DMEM and incubate for 48 h at 37 °C with 5% CO2.
Prepare fibroblast expansion medium by adding 5.0 mL of FBS and 0.5 mL of L-glutamine to 44.5 mL of advanced DMEM, store at +4 °C.
Combine 32 µL of OSKMNL NM-RNA, 24 µL of EKB NM-RNA, and 5.6 µL of NM-microRNAs in each of 9 sterile RNase-free tubes (61.6 µL final volume).
Divide each tube into four 15.4 µL single-use aliquots in sterile, RNase-free tubes.
Store the aliquots at -80 °C.
Thaw BMM overnight on ice in a refrigerator.
Dilute BMM with ice-cold serum-free medium.
Use pre-cooled pipets, tips, and tubes.
Prepare a 24-well plate by coating each well with 100 µL of BMM.
Incubate the coated wells for at least 1 h at 37 °C before seeding cells.
Aspirate the medium from plates containing cells in culture.
Quickly wash the plates twice in 1x PBS.
Repeat trypsinization to obtain cells at passage 5.
Aspirate the supernatant after trypsinization.
Resuspend the pellet in an appropriate volume of fibroblasts expansion medium.
Prepare and clean the hemocytometer with 70% alcohol.
Gently mix 10 µl of trypan blue with 10 µL of cell suspension in a 1.5 mL tube.
Incubate for 1–2 min at room temperature.
Pipette 10 µL of the solution into the hemocytometer and place it on an inverted phase contrast microscope stage to count cells.
Count the viable (unstained) and non-viable (blue stained) cells in at least 2 squares of the hemocytometer chamber.
Dilute cells to obtain a density of 2.5 x 10^4 cells per 500 μL of fibroblasts expansion medium.
Resuspend the cell pellet in an appropriate volume of fibroblasts expansion medium.
Pipette 500 µl of the diluted cell suspension into each well of a 24-well plate.
Incubate cells overnight at 37°C and 5% CO2.
Warm up xeno-free, serum-free, low growth factor human ESC/iPSC culture medium in a 37°C water bath.
Remove old medium from each well and replace with 500 µl of pre-warmed XF/FF culture medium.
Incubate at 37°C under 5% CO2 for at least 6 hours.
Thaw five 15.4 µL aliquots of total NM-RNA reprogramming cocktail at room temperature, then place on ice.
Add 234.6 µl of reduced-serum medium to each thawed aliquot, gently pipette 3–5 times and label as TUBE A (RNA + reduced-serum medium).
Label five sterile RNase-free 0.5 ml tubes as TUBE B.
Mix 6 µL of synthetic siRNA transfection reagent with 244 µl of reduced-serum medium in each tube, labeling as RNA-transfection reagent + reduced-serum medium.
Add the contents of each TUBE B dropwise to TUBE A (to obtain 500 µL final volume of NM-RNA transfection complex solution).
Mix by tapping the bottom of the tube.
Incubate at room temperature for 15 min.
Add 125 µL of NM-RNA transfection complex solution from each of the five aliquots to 4 wells, tilting the plate and pipetting dropwise into the medium.
Mix by rocking gently.
Use the remaining 4 wells as a reference.
Incubate for 15 h at 37 °C, 5% CO2.
Aspirate the medium.
Repeat the transfection procedure under the sterile hood.
Exchange the medium with fresh, pre-warmed XF/FF culture medium under a sterile hood.
Incubate overnight at 37 °C, 5% CO2.
Monitor daily by phase-contrast microscope for formation of iPSC colonies.
